verdict.rationale: Lambda's API, cloud-init launch-time configuration, and Slurm's automatic job scheduling (docs-5, docs-6, docs-37) let users programmatically launch instances and queue jobs that run unattended, and a community-built MCP/CLI tool shows agents can drive this today (lambda-labs-comm-1). However, this is infrastructure-level automation, not a built-in 'set up autonomous background automation' feature, and Lambda explicitly does not distinguish idle vs in-use state or offer auto-stop, leaving a real gap in autonomous resource management (lambda-labs-comm-2). Missing for 10: native scheduler/trigger system for recurring automations, built-in idle/auto-shutdown automation, first-party agent orchestration beyond raw API/Slurm.
